details.story: As an Applicant, I want to save a draft of my application, so that I can complete and submit it later.
details.reason: Complex applications often cannot be completed in one session.

details.story: As an Applicant, I want to request an inspection for my issued permit, so that the County can schedule and perform required inspections.
details.reason: Inspections are typically initiated by the applicant rather than staff alone.

details.story: As an Applicant, I want to receive automated notifications when my application status changes or review comments are posted, so that I can take timely action.
details.reason: Manually checking status does not ensure timely awareness of required actions.

details.story: As an Applicant, I want to withdraw a submitted application, so that processing stops and any applicable refund process can begin.
details.reason: The application lifecycle lacks an applicant-initiated stop before final action.

details.story: As an Applicant, I want to upload requested corrections and additional documents in response to a staff request, so that my application can proceed after review findings.
details.reason: Review processes generate requests for missing or corrected items that must be returned by the applicant.

details.story: As an Applicant, I want to view itemized fees and payment history for my application, so that I understand what I owe and what has already been paid.
details.reason: Payment visibility is needed beyond the initial payment action.

details.story: As a Staff member, I want to assess and adjust fees on an application, so that the Applicant is charged the correct amount.
details.reason: Fee payment requires an accurate fee determination step before payment.

details.story: As a Staff member, I want to send a formal request for additional information or corrections to the Applicant, so that deficiencies identified during review can be resolved.
details.reason: Reviews identify deficiencies but no outgoing request mechanism is described.

details.story: As a Staff member, I want to monitor application and review deadlines against service levels, so that I can adjust workloads and avoid delays.
details.reason: Workload stories reference service levels but lack deadline tracking and escalation.

details.story: As a Staff member, I want to schedule and publish public hearing dates and agendas, so that Applicants and Staff can prepare for hearing requirements.
details.reason: Hearing readiness assumes a scheduled hearing date exists.

details.story: As an Applicant, I want to file an appeal of a decision, so that I can initiate the appeals process and have the decision reconsidered.
details.reason: Staff can process appeals, but applicant initiation of an appeal is not covered.

details.story: As a Public User, I want to report a possible code violation, so that the County can investigate and take enforcement action.
details.reason: Enforcement notices imply a source of violation reports from the public.

details.story: As an Enforcement Staff member, I want to create and manage an enforcement case, so that I can track violation details, evidence, and resolution from complaint to closure.
details.reason: Notices and fines need a case record to track the full enforcement lifecycle.

details.story: As a Staff member, I want to track conditions of approval and required clearances, so that permits and occupancy are not issued until all requirements are met.

As a Data Consuming User, I want to be able to share a view state as a URL to social networks, So that I can share data that I have found with others.

As a Data Consuming User, I want to be able to have stepped zoom on map visualisations, So that I can have better control over the navigation experience inside a map view.
As an API User, I want to be able to dynamically request polygons based on the query made, So that I can provide maps that match the query.
As an API User, I want to have a flexible API using HASC codes for countries, regions and cities, So that I can visualise budget data on maps.
As an API User, I want to be able to get a set of monetary measures transferred to different currencies, So that I can use this in scenarios that might enable comparison by normalisation.
As an API User, I want to be able to normalise measures by GINI and related socioeconomic indexes, So that I work with datasets in reference to their contextual constraints.
As an OpenSpending Community Member, I want to have an app where I can find examples of use of fiscal data visualisations, So that I can find guidance in creating my own with Open Spending.

As a Data Consuming User, I want to visualize by default in treemap, bubble tree, map and pivot table the most recent year when my dataset contain multiple years, So that I'm not confused with the amounts.

details.story: As an Application Administrator, I want to deactivate or suspend a User account, so that former staff members cannot access the system.
details.reason: The backlog covers user creation and password resets but not account lifecycle deactivation.

details.story: As a User, I want to change my own password, so that I can maintain account security without waiting for an administrator.
details.reason: Only an administrator reset is covered, not self-service password management.

details.story: As an Application Administrator, I want to assign Users to specific repositories, so that staff only access records in their own repository.
details.reason: Repository-scoped search and permissions imply repository-level user assignment is needed.

details.story: As an Archivist, I want to create and edit Accession records, so that I can manage unprocessed acquisitions before they become Resources.
details.reason: Accessions appear in search but no creation or editing story is present.

details.story: As an Archivist, I want to create and edit Resource Components (Archival Objects), so that I can describe a Resource hierarchy.
details.reason: Existing stories reference components for identifiers, levels, and rearrangement but not their creation.

details.story: As an Archivist, I want to create and edit Subject records, so that I can maintain controlled subject headings for linking to Resources.
details.reason: Subjects are referenced for identifiers and linking, but subject record management is missing.

details.story: As an Application Administrator, I want to create and edit Repository records, so that I can manage the institutions or divisions using ArchivesSpace.
details.reason: Repository properties are mentioned but the core repository record management is not covered.

details.story: As an Archivist, I want to export Resource descriptions as EAD, so that I can share finding aids with other systems and users.
details.reason: EAD import is covered from multiple sources but no EAD export story exists.

details.story: As an Archivist, I want to export Resource descriptions as MARCXML, so that I can contribute records to library catalogs.
details.reason: MARCXML import is covered but export is not mentioned.

details.story: As an Archivist, I want to search across all repositories, so that I can locate materials regardless of repository assignment.
details.reason: The only search story is scoped to a single repository.

details.story: As an Archivist, I want to generate a finding aid or box list report from a Resource, so that I can produce a printable representation of a collection.
details.reason: No reporting or printable output stories are present despite rich Resource description data.

details.story: As an Archivist, I want to view a history of changes made to a record, so that I can audit edits and understand past decisions.
details.reason: Conflict prevention is covered but no audit trail or record history is mentioned.

details.story: As an Archivist, I want to bulk update or create records from a CSV or spreadsheet import, so that I can efficiently manage large datasets.
details.reason: Only enum values have a bulk update story; general record bulk operations are missing.

details.story: As an Archivist, I want to create and edit Location records, so that I can track storage locations available for containers.
details.reason: Containers can be assigned locations, but location record management is not covered.

details.story: As an Archivist, I want to create and edit Container or Top Container records, so that I can track physical storage units and their locations.
details.reason: Instances are associated with containers and locations, but container management itself is missing.

details.story: As an Archivist, I want to associate a Digital Object with an Instance, so that I can link a digital surrogate to an archival description.
details.reason: Instances are associated with Resources and Components, but linking to Digital Objects is not explicit.

details.story: As an Archivist, I want to publish selected archival descriptions to a public interface, so that researchers can discover and use materials.
details.reason: The backlog focuses on staff functions but omits the public discovery layer.

details.story: As an Application Administrator, I want to configure LDAP or SSO authentication, so that users can log in with institutional credentials.
details.reason: Only local authentication is covered, and enterprise deployments typically need directory integration.

details.story: As a Developer, I want to use a REST API to create and update archival records, so that I can integrate external systems with ArchivesSpace.
details.reason: A custom importer is mentioned but general API access is not covered.

details.story: As an Archivist, I want to merge duplicate Agent or Subject records, so that I can clean up authority data and avoid multiple headings for the same entity.
details.reason: Agent and Subject records are managed but no merge/deduplication workflow is present.

details.story: As an Archivist, I want to track the status of background import and export jobs, so that I know when processing is complete or if it failed.
details.reason: Import error messages exist, but asynchronous job status is not covered.

details.story: As an Archivist, I want to create and edit Digital Object Components, so that I can describe hierarchical parts of a digital object.
details.reason: Digital Object management and hierarchy rearrangement are covered, but component creation is not explicit.

suggestions: As a depositor, I want to select a license or rights statement when depositing, so that data reusers know what reuse is permitted.

As a depositor, I want to receive notifications when a deposit is approved, rejected, or made public, so that I know the status of my data.
As a depositor, I want to view download and usage statistics for my own datasets, so that I can demonstrate the impact and reuse of my data.
As a depositor, I want to upload a folder or batch of files in one deposit, so that I do not need to select and describe files one by one.
As a depositor, I want to pause and resume large file uploads, so that network interruptions do not force me to restart the entire deposit.
As a depositor, I want to link my dataset to related datasets or previous versions, so that researchers can discover connected work.

As a data reuser, I want to download selected files or a complete dataset, so that I can actually use the data I find.
As a data reuser, I want to view the license or terms of use for a dataset, so that I know what I am allowed to do with the data.
As a data reuser, I want to request access to embargoed or restricted data, so that I can ask for legitimate access without needing an existing privileged account.

As a data reuser, I want to report a broken file or incorrect metadata, so that the archive can maintain reliable records.

As a research facility manager, I want to set access and embargo conditions for datasets deposited on behalf of researchers, so that facility data follows the same policy rules.
As a Bath Data Archive administrator, I want to manage embargo expiry and release datasets according to their schedule, so that data does not remain restricted longer than intended.

As a UnivITservice, I want to monitor storage usage and system health, so that I can ensure capacity and availability for archived data.

As a developer, I want to search and retrieve metadata or datasets via the API, so that external services can build discovery and reuse tools on top of the archive.
